name: Hikagari Tobari
source: A refined woman. Ex-hacker. Seemingly freelance, doing all sorts of jobs. Her hacking, too, fell under this umbrella. Collected, and able to take a step back to observe.
translation: A refined woman. Ex-hacker. Seemingly freelance, doing all sorts of jobs. Her hacking, too, fell under this umbrella. Collected, and able to take a step back to observe.
